changes.after_question: İnternetim yavaşlıyor veya bağlantım sürekli kesiliyor, ne yapabilirim?
changes.reason: Existing troubleshooting steps support slow connection and repeated dropouts; make intended supported query scope explicit.
Embed question and curated keywords as FAQ intent; keep full authoritative answer in payload, avoiding long-answer dilution.
Normalize dotted and dotless uppercase I before tokenization; avoid a spurious one-letter i token causing false keyword matches.

limitations: These are development-set changes, not heldout evidence.
After results reflect both corpus coverage and index representation changes; do not attribute all gains to one change.
No label changes or acceptance threshold lowering were used.
Local hybrid measurements do not verify remote payload indexes, network latency or HNSW.
migration: Use a fresh Qdrant collection and explicit ingestion after document representation/model changes even if dimensions match; switch API only after readiness.
